featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience.

The person running this photo studio is extremely rude and unprofessional. I went there specifically to get U.S. visa photos, and he confidently claimed that he knows exactly how the U.S. visa photo requirements work.

However, the photos he took were clearly pixelated and of very poor quality, and they were rejected at the embassy. Because of this mistake, we had to take new photos at the embassy itself and pay an additional premium fee, which could have easily been avoided if the photos were taken properly in the first place.

When we went back and informed him about the rejection and the poor photo quality, instead of taking responsibility he simply said “that’s the embassy’s problem, they reject photos all the time” and refused to acknowledge the issue. If he already knows that photos taken at his studio are getting rejected frequently, then he should inform customers beforehand instead of confidently claiming expertise.

The amount we paid may only be ₹200, but the point is not the money — it’s about basic professionalism and customer respect. Customers should not have to waste their time and money because of poor service and misinformation.

On top of that, his attitude towards customers is extremely rude and dismissive. No willingness to listen, no accountability, and no respect.

I would strongly advise people to avoid this studio for visa photos or any important documentation photos.

10/10 we will recommend Akshay & Team to everyone.

featured_reviews.review_text: There are literally no words to describe Akshay Sansare photography. I was absolutely honored to have him & his team to play such a large role in my wedding. I can't recommend him enough!Special Thanks to Akshay Sansare & his great supportive team as well....

featured_reviews.name: Ankur Murkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The easiest decision of our wedding was made when Akshay was recommended to us. We found Akshay and his team to be very creative, professional and talented. From initial consultation through to the Sangeet, Wedding and Reception, every thing was flawless. He has an incredible eye for detail when it came to choosing the decorations for the wedding day, which we wouldn’t even think of. And personally for me the song selection for the film was absolutely amazing. Our family and friends were more than happy with the photos and the cinematic wedding film. We are truly grateful. Thank You.

featured_reviews.name: Varsha Sachdeva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Akshay is a wonderful photographer and we wouldn't hesitate a bit to recommend him to anyone!

Tushar and me were initially very worried about our wedding photos and how they'd turn as we  both are not the most comfortable in front of the camera. Until we met Akshay! He made us so comfortable and was the most perfect photographer.

Akshay and his team managed to capture perfect amount of staged and candid pictures and even included some very emotional ones which sum up our relationship so perfectly.

Thanks a million Akshay and team for giving us such wonderful memories for our lifetime :)

featured_reviews.name: Swapna Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had seen your wedding video of Pankaj and Jyotsna 'Julun yeti reshimgathi' long back and decided then and there that whenever I get married, none other than Akshay Sansare will capture my big day. Their communication approach was very friendly yet clear. The way Akshay explained me everything, gave me clarity of how the process will be which felt assuring and made me worry free. Akshay helped me choose the colour scheme of my engagement decore and makeup artists which helped in easing my prep tension. Team Akshay Sansare is as cooperative and friendly as the man himself. So kudos to the entire team. Their team was super clam as compared to photographers I have observed in other weddings. They captured every moment in the wedding without disturbing the subjects in any way. All the pictures are beautiful. The teaser was repeatedly playing on my phone! That says it all !  In the album, great emphasis was given on the wedding rituals and important moments, keeping the magic intact. The Cinematic Wedding Film was beyond expectations and I have no words to explain how happy I am about it. God bless Akshay and Team. The entire wedding photography process was truly effortless for us.
About budget Definitely we had to make a choice to spend 3x more than the quotation of other photographers. But I trust the magic that Akshay brings into your special moments and that's why decided to choose Akshay, irrespective of the price. However, when watching Akshay's magic in all the pictures and the cinematic video, the money we spent was not even a background thought. His magic is totally worth for the fees he asks.
We recommend Akshay & Team to every one !

featured_reviews.name: anjali ghodake
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hats off to Akshay Sansare and team 👏
We are so grateful that we had you guys to capture our big day! Thank you so much, you guys have done an amazing job and we are just so happy looking at the outcome which we will cherish life long. All the emotions, candid moments were captured so beautifully and everything from song selection to every little detail was there on point! We still can’t get over it❤️😍
Highly recommended!!!!
